about: Walkdown Plant realism vectors (docs/plant3d/REALISM.md §13), made by ref/make_plant3d_vectors.py from ref/plant3d.py, ref/plant3d_staff.py and ref/plant3d_world.py. Milestone RE1: the world's random streams by purpose and item (`streams`: each stream's first state and draws), and the synthetic plant with staff whose model reads the clock values (`staff`: its files, counts, rejects and runs, as plant3d-v2.json's `staff`; a run's `files` replace the base's, its `staff` null keeps the base's staff.json; its `world` is the world's seed and year day as the engine took them). Milestone AG1 (§2.2, §4.2–§4.3, J0): `wear`, the same plant with a pump that wears (draw, wear and count nodes, a work's renews, age_rate, wear across a jump), as `staff`; milestone WX1 (§5.1): `weather`, the same plant with weather.json and the weather step (seeded by season, fixed, scripted, the instructor's input, a jump); milestone HW1 (§2.3–§2.7, §2.13): `hands`, the same plant with tools.json, hand actions, meters, a HART op, hidden causes and cures, and an NPC's job with tools and slips; milestone HS7 (§8.5): `audio`, the safety staff with personal audio banned in zones, an Ex zone, music and phone inputs, noticing by drawn delays and by missed calls, the device held until the duty ends; milestone AG3 (§2.19): `lab`, the hands part's plant with an oil sampling kit, a vibration data collector and a thermal camera, sample nodes taken by hand actions, the lab's results after clock hours from the lab streams, and an NPC's round; milestone HS1 (§8.6): `hse`, the safety staff with hse.json (the hazard library), works with a job kind, JSAs and toolbox talks by NPCs and trainees, the issue refused without a JSA, the talk's attendance; milestone WM1 (§2.20): `wo`, the staff plant with workorders.json, work orders moved by their inputs, by themselves and by NPCs, and reactions on their states; milestone DC3 (§6.3.1): `discuss`, the staff plant with discussions.json, the discuss step's lead and joiners, modes npc and open, picks and their reasons, defaults, agreements and an outcome task. A run's `files` are those that differ from its part's. Numbers compare to 1e-6; the digests (§17.14) of every 50th step are exact.

a world in a version 1 scenario
a value named like a clock value

runs.why: the bearing wears while the pump runs (age_rate 50, a training rate: 6e-4 a step at full flow), up to its life drawn at step 0 from its own stream; the fault at that step; a count of starts and of trips (by 8); the trainer's reset (f_new) zeroes the wear and the trips' count; the pump started again wears from 0, its failure not applied again; run_h counts running hours, clock_s clock seconds; the draws with an init (their own) keep it
the plant's age and a real rate (§4.3): the scenario starts the wear at 0.25, the starts' count at 3, run_h at 1200, gives brg_life_c, and age_rate 1 (real time: 1.2e-5 a step)
a renewal (§2.2): the pump's work renews the bearing when its permit goes to done with its isolation complete: the wear 0 in that step's step 3, read by the next step
no renewal with a lock removed by authority in done's own step (§2.2, as its repairs: the isolation is incomplete after that step's locks)

wear across a jump (§2.2, §17.6): from 23:00 with the pump running, the trainee (mech1) jumps to 05:45 at step 30: each wear node adds rate × the gap's clock seconds once, at the rate of the step before, then its step, then its max (the bearing to 1, its failure); clock_s by the 24,300 s of the gap

the jump's step reads the rate of the step before (§2.2): the trainee (c_fo) stops the pump in the jump's own step; run_h still adds the running rate × the gap and the step, its rate 0 from the next step

the season changes at midnight (year day 300 is summer's last): the hours' draws after midnight use winter's rows (rain at 01:00, which summer's rows never give)
fixed weather and the instructor (§5.1): fixed clear; the instructor sets dust at step 200 (its event, then the weather event in step 1w), an unknown kind at step 300 does nothing, rain at step 400
scripted weather: the entry at or before the start (05:00 clear), rain at 06:00, clear at 06:20, dust at 06:40; the instructor's sandstorm-like dust at 06:10 holds until the next entry

a jump (§17.6) from 23:03 to 05:45 across six whole hours of seeded weather: one draw per whole hour crossed, in order, in the jump's step; the driven values set to their targets (the night passed); one weather event for the net change
the people's draws with weather (§2.1): the synthetic staff's morning with seeded weather: the same events as without weather but the weather's own (the test replays it without)

a value weight (§2.6): with the terminal left loose (g1_body_loose 1) its cause weighs 7 of 12; the trainer's fault pressed and repaired ten times, each draw from the stream

runs.why: field operator 1 of crew A plays music at volume 30 from step 1500 (under the mask): in the pump hall an act of kind audio; each observer of the stop reaction sharing the hall draws the minutes they take to notice from their own stream (forgotten when they leave); the first whose time comes is given the stop; the stop holds the device (event held), turns the music off and gives the put-right task; their audio and phone inputs refused (held) until their duty ends (a jump past 18:00: event returned), then played again

the same at volume 60 (at or over the mask): every message to the operator or their role is missed (event missed); one missed while the act goes on reports it, and the stop goes at once to the first of the roles on duty wherever they are; from 17:00, so the device held comes back when the operator's duty ends (18:00: event returned) and their music plays again; inputs of no volume ignored

the phone left at a locker (music off with it, and an audio input refused: left), taken again and music on before the morning round: an act of kind audio from the hall, then in the tank yard (an Ex zone) one of kind phone, unnoticed (nobody of the roles near), both ended on leaving; the next round's act in the hall noticed and stopped; a phone input not leave or take ignored (the trainee arrives at a locker for each: the engine checks it since the phone-music follow-ups)
with seed 3 in the world: other noticing draws, the same rules
without audio: the audio and phone inputs refused (no_audio), no act; in free mode (no trainee) they do nothing

runs.why: samples taken (§2.19): at the toolbox, without the kit (tool) and away from the gauge (where); at the gauge without the kit (tool), by another person (authority), then taken at once (both nodes, each drawing its own lab stream; the iron the pump's pressure as the previous step left it), again (two queued with their dues), a timed one (2 minutes: its sample in step 3 at its end, the iron as that step left it); the collector and the camera read through their meters; the results come in step 3 at their dues, each with its lab event (lab_vis given 70 by the scenario until its first result); eight queued: the next sample refused lab, taken again once the queue has room
the sample authority (§2.19): a role with operate_local but not sample is refused authority for a sampling hand action, and still makes a bare-hand one (clean_glass, operate_local)

messages.round_done: Round done, readings in the log
messages.check_alarm: Check the alarm at the pump

runs.why: results across a jump (§2.19): a sample taken at 07:30, then a jump to 06:30 of day 2: both results come in the jump's own step (their dues long passed), one lab event each; a sample after the jump queued from the new clock

an NPC's condition monitoring round (§2.19): ic1 (no trainee) takes the kit, the collector and the camera at 07:45, reads the gauge's vibration (out of its expected range: a finding) and temperature, takes a sample at once and a timed one, puts the tools back; the results come 6 and 12 clock minutes later

a queue filled under a timed action (§2.19, settled in the code): a session, slot 0 ic1 and slot 1 ic2, each with a kit at the gauge; ic1 takes seven samples, ic2 starts the timed one with the queue at 7, ic1 takes the eighth while it is under way: at its end ic2's action is done but takes no sample and draws nothing (the next sample's spread is the stream's ninth draw), ic2's next refused lab; a timed one once the queue has room takes its sample
